auditors_unavailable.ARE: The Central Bank of the UAE Annual Report 2025 (centralbank.ae/media/pjimtxfq/annual-report-2025-en.pdf) was read in three windows. Section 14.1 states only that "The financial statements are audited by independent external auditor appointed by the Board" and that the auditor gave an unqualified opinion for the year ended 31 December 2025; section 14.2 prints the balance sheet and highlights but no independent auditor's report, so the firm is not named in the document. Recordable fact if useful: the external auditor is appointed by the Board (public-body/private split unknown).
auditors_unavailable.EGY: Article 36 of Egypt's Central Bank and Banking Sector Law No. 194 of 2020 states the Bank's accounts shall be audited by two external auditors drawn from the registered auditors, one appointed by the Central Auditing Organization and the other by the Board upon the Audit Committee's nomination, with fees agreed between the Bank and the Central Auditing Organization, and these audits substitute for the Central Auditing Organization's own audits; the law does not name the firms. Source: Banking Law No. 194 of 2020 (English translation, Andersen Egypt) (https://eg.andersen.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/banking-law-no-194-of-2020.pdf).

auditors_unavailable.PAN: Not researched as a central bank: Panama has no central bank (it uses the US dollar and has no monetary authority issuing currency), so there is no central bank audit record to find. Flagging for the caller to confirm how the map treats Panama.
auditors_unavailable.UZB: Statute confirms a mechanism, names no firm. Article 8 of the Law on the Central Bank of the Republic of Uzbekistan (LRU-582, 11 November 2019) provides that the Senate of the Oliy Majlis considers the Central Bank's annual report together with the conclusion of the audit organization, and article 15 sets the 15 May deadline for submitting that report. So an external audit exists by law and its conclusion goes to the Senate. The published annual reports carry no financial statements and no auditor's report: the 2025 report was read and KPMG appears in it only as an adviser on buy-now-pay-later regulation, not as auditor. Same position as Egypt's article 36 - a named mechanism is not a named firm, so nothing was filed. Untried: the Senate's own record of the conclusion it receives, and the xarid.uzex.uz procurement award.
auditors_unavailable.PRY: Searches for Banco Central del Paraguay audited financial statements or an independent auditor's report returned only commercial-bank balance sheets; no central bank auditor could be named within budget.
auditors_unavailable.MAC: Settled negatively on a primary official source. The Autoridade Monetaria de Macau publishes its Relatorio e contas in the Macao official gazette (Boletim Oficial, II Serie supplements) rather than on its own site, which is why the rebuilt amcm.gov.mo exposes no annual report index. The 2018 report (images.io.gov.mo/bo/ii/2019/18/bo-ii-18-sup2-2019.pdf) was read in full. Its section 3.3.3 is headed "Auditoria interna e externa" but its text covers only the internal Gabinete de Auditoria Interna, and item 5 is the opinion of the AMCM's own Comissao de Fiscalizacao, a statutory supervisory committee, which relies on the monthly accounts the AMCM sends it and on explanations from the board. No audit firm appears anywhere in the document. The gazette indexes for the 2004 and 2010 reports show the same structure. The AMCM names no external auditor of its own accounts, so this is a confirmed blank and not a retry target.
auditors_unavailable.MWI: Reserve Bank of Malawi: the only located copy of the RBM Financial Statement 31 December 2024 is a Scribd upload, which returns a JavaScript-required error page and cannot be read. regalert.today document 9cb1c8e7 turned out to be the Financial Services (Annual Audits of Banks) Directive 2018, which regulates audits of supervised banks and names no auditor of the RBM itself.
auditors_unavailable.MDG: Loi n 2016-004 portant statut de la Banque Centrale de Madagascar (assemblee-nationale.mg) was read: Article 76 provides for 'un Cabinet d'audit' / 'auditeur externe' appointed by the Conseil d'administration, Article 73 has the Board appoint the external auditor on the Audit Committee's proposal, and Article 85 says the statements are audited by an external auditor designated under Article 76. No firm or body is named. The Cour des Comptes appears in Articles 34 and 7 only as a recipient of the annual report and as a body against which the Bank's autonomy cannot be invoked, not as auditor. An IMF French staff report search returned no auditor name.
auditors_unavailable.COG: Congo-Brazzaville has no national central bank of its own: it is a member of BEAC, whose auditor could not be read (see the CMR note). No Congo-specific BEAC national directorate audit document was found.
auditors_unavailable.TCD: Chad has no national central bank of its own: it is a member of BEAC, whose auditor could not be read (see the CMR note). No Chad-specific BEAC national directorate audit document was found.
auditors_unavailable.MRT: Banque Centrale de Mauritanie. A French search for the annual report, commissaire aux comptes and auditeur externe returned only Mauritanian utility audit terms of reference, PEFA and World Bank ROSC accounting reports. IMF French report cr18356f was read in full: it is an external-sector-statistics technical assistance report that discusses the BCM's balance of payments work and lists officials met, and names no external auditor.
auditors_unavailable.CPV: Banco de Cabo Verde. Two Portuguese searches for the relatorio e contas, auditor externo, certificacao legal das contas and the big-four firm names returned only Cabo Verdean commercial banks (Caixa Economica, BCN, BAI, Banco Interatlantico) and press summaries of BCV results. Boletim Oficial bulletin 735 on boe.incv.cv was read: it discusses the BCV only as the monetary authority; its auditing references are to Banco Interatlantico's Conselho Fiscal (individuals, not a firm) and to Deloitte & Associados SROC as fiscal unico of A Promotora, an unrelated venture-capital company. No BCV auditor's report was readable.
auditors_unavailable.PSE: Palestine Monetary Authority. Two searches for the annual report, financial statements and independent auditor's report returned only PMA press releases, PCBS balance-of-payments releases, centralbanking.com summaries, and regalert.today copies of PMA circulars. regalert.today document e95ea4e9-2d85-4d9e-94a3-db111c766ec1 was read: it is PMA Circular No. (9) 2012 on BANKS' external auditors under Article 47 of Banking Law No. 9 of 2010, and names no firm for the PMA's own accounts. No PMA auditor's report was reachable.
auditors_unavailable.YEM: Central Bank of Yemen. A search for its audited financial statements and independent auditor's report returned only Yemeni commercial banks (National Bank of Yemen, International Bank of Yemen), the IFRS Yemen jurisdiction profile, a Crowe Yemen service page and UNOPS audit reports. No CBY financial statements or auditor's report was reachable, and neither the Aden nor the Sanaa administration publishes one that search surfaced.

auditors_unavailable.VEN: Banco Central de Venezuela. No source naming the BCV's external auditor was readable.
auditors_unavailable.STP: Banco Central de Sao Tome e Principe. Checked November 2026.
